entities.name: Appius Claudius Sabinus Inregillensis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Appius Claudius Sabinus Regillensis or Inregillensis was the legendary founder of the Roman gens Claudia, and consul in 495 BC. He was the leading figure of the aristocratic party in the early Roman Republic.
